title: Composition and locale implementation mapping
summary: Exact M0 map of configuration inheritance, locale routing and current composition boundaries.
current_behavior: Configuration resolves defaults, docara.json, every section.json from root to leaf and an optional page sidecar with pointer-level provenance.
LocaleRegistry supports arbitrary well-formed locale definitions, prefixes, fallbacks and direction.
The documentation site currently declares only ru content, while five bundled language packs exist.
DeclarativePageCompiler resolves region composition into layout, sections and blocks.
known_deviations: Current schemas still allow title and page description in composition JSON.
No front matter parser owns target page metadata.
The shipped documentation site does not prove separate Markdown trees for multiple locales.
Current public strings still come from legacy language-pack records instead of target content/<locale>/lang.json.
Current site/config surfaces predate the accepted no-site.json-compatibility target.
The former global source_ownership gate-order conflict is resolved by DOC-ADR-015 and badge_source_ready.
deletion_gates: Remove generated-base config resolution only after all public generated routes have physical sources.
Remove prose-bearing config fields only after front matter/site-copy ownership and migration tests pass.
Remove silent locale presentation fallback only after explicit missing-page policy tests pass.
